notes: Peek at other characters' phones. Tap 👀 at the top of your phone, pick someone, and look through their phone: their texts with you, contacts, photos, posts, wallet and bag, today's calendar, notes on what they remember, apps their profile mentions (like Godfinger or stocks) and their wallpaper. It only shows what the story already knows and changes nothing

Each chat keeps its own memories. Starting over or starting a new chat after deleting one could bring back what characters remembered from the old chat; deleted chats now take their remembered moments with them
Fixed an error when you switched chats while a background moment was still being written; that moment is now simply dropped instead of landing in the wrong story
